decision: Venue-specific normalization creates viable Binance signals but no standalone consistent profit. ASTER_H1/48_TP8 has all-period positive PnL but forward matched control fails. No deployment.

protocol.signal: Binance rolling z-score of signed 3h taker imbalance vs previous 30d disjoint 3h buckets, strictly excludes current bucket, min60 observations. Absorption SHORT when positive imbalance, z>=1 and price falls, volume ratio>=1.2; strict z>=1.5 and ratio>=1.5. Continuation SHORT when imbalance<0,z<=-1, price falls, ratio>=1.2. ASTER original fixed 15% absorption comparator. Each arm separately ranks candidates by its own score. All initial gates predeclared after R14, exploratory.
protocol.definitions: BOTH_NORM both venues absorption; ASTER_BINANCE_NOT_BULL ASTER absorption and Binance price3h<=0; ASTER_BINANCE_CONT ASTER absorption plus Binance continuation; BINANCE_ASTER_PRICE normalized Binance absorption plus ASTER price3h negative; LAG normalized Binance absorption price3h <= ASTER return3h minus0.5pp. Confirmation same R14 causal QA.
protocol.exits: H24/H48 fixed and TP8 at each horizon, STOP8 conservative same-bar stop first; adverse gap; gross .30 2 slots, 12h cooldown, 10/30bps. Fixed boundary exclusions before replay. Funding sensitivity TARGET only if all rates archived, actual signed funding based on M5 mark proxy; funding cashflows included chronologically in equity, entry and exit boundary events excluded with explicit count.
protocol.controls: 32 same-time other-symbol controls on all fixed H48 variants with >=2 positive splits, plus BINANCE_NORM/24, BINANCE_NORM/48, BINANCE_CONT/48, ASTER/48 and ASTER_H1/48.
protocol.limits: Data Binance archive monthly through Oct2026, daily through Nov25; 26 daily absent outside entry period. No OI/board/liq in this run. All periods previously inspected.
protocol.funding: Same TARGET funding proxy as R14. Missing rate coverage independently reviewed.
